title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Lisbon
description: Capture Lisbon's magic! Discover the 12 best photography spots for stunning cityscapes, historic alleys, vibrant street art, and breathtaking sunsets. Plan your perfect photo tour.

places.name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing Sagres beer from one of the occasional street vendors to enjoy with the view.

places.name: Alfama District
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Pastel de Nata from a small, local bakery tucked away in an alley.

places.name: Belém Tower (Torre de Belém) & Monument to the Discoveries
places.priceRange: Belém Tower €8.00 / $8.70 (exterior free); Monument free to view (interior €6.00 / $6.50)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in the famous Pastéis de Belém from the original factory nearby after your shoot.

places.name: Praça do Comércio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a coffee from a cafe with outdoor seating overlooking the square for a break.

places.name: Castelo de São Jorge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a cool drink from the cafe inside the castle walls while admiring the panoramic views.

places.name: Santa Justa Lift (Elevador de Santa Justa)
places.priceRange: €5.30 / $5.75 for round trip + viewpoint access (free with Viva Viagem card within 24hr validity)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gelato from a nearby shop to enjoy while waiting in line or once you reach the top.

places.name: LX Factory
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A craft beer from one of the many unique bars or a delicious brunch at one of the trendy restaurants like 'Rio Maravilha'.

places.name: Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing 'água de coco' (coconut water) from a vendor, often found near the viewpoint.

places.name: Pink Street (Rua Nova do Carvalho)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A shot of Ginjinha from a nearby bar as you explore the lively Cais do Sodré area.

places.name: Parque Eduardo VII
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A picnic lunch to enjoy in the park after capturing its grandeur.

places.name: Tram 28 (Elétrico 28)
places.priceRange: €3.00 / $3.25 for a single ride (free with Viva Viagem 24hr pass)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Bifana (pork sandwich) from a local 'tasca' near one of the tram stops, a quick and authentic Portuguese bite.

places.name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing glass of Vinho Verde from a nearby kiosk or cafe, enjoyed with the view.
